name: outside
description: Nothing raised: 1.05 km away; 170 m above; next to a drone that is not live; a 31 s old position; a closest approach 80+ s away. Absence is reported only as no ADS-B traffic reported within 3 km, with the data age.
worked_example: UAL123 1050 m N of D9A03 (vert +50): beyond 1000 m -> no NEAR; flying away -> no CPA.
N12345 600 m S at 320 m: vert +170 > 150 -> nothing. N9 200 m from DJI-1, which is not live -> nothing. N10 424 m away but 31 s old (not fresh) -> nothing.
SKW9 5.2 km N heading S at 120 kt while D9A03 flies E at 5 m/s: t_cpa = 5200*61.73/(61.73^2+5^2) = 83.7 s > 60 -> nothing.
No fresh aircraft within 3 km of the observer (4 km S): 'no ADS-B traffic reported within 3 km, data 4 s old' - never 'clear' or 'no traffic'.

expect.summary: no ADS-B traffic reported within 3 km, data 4 s old
